header.contentDescription: Five regular polygons tested for whether they tile the plane, selected with buttons, the tiles pulling apart and closing again

children.value: tap one, and watch it try to close

drawTextAnchored.text: interior angle 60.0, and 6 of them make 360.0
closes exactly - it tiles the plane
interior angle 90.0, and 4 of them make 360.0
closes exactly - it tiles the plane
interior angle 108.0, and 3 of them make 324.0
cannot close - it leaves a gap
interior angle 120.0, and 3 of them make 360.0
closes exactly - it tiles the plane
interior angle 128.6, and 2 of them make 257.1
cannot close - it leaves a gap
Only three regular polygons tile the plane, and the test is one line of arithmetic:
the interior angle must divide 360 exactly. 60, 90 and 120 do. 108 and 128.6 do not.
